A '''clan''' of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] had bred the vicious creatures known as [[boma]]s for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when they allowed interested individuals to visit their breeding pens and study the creatures.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Boma Breeding}}</ref>
